prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: low-speed head-on collision. Injury: neck and back strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1490; do not mention it.)
text:
We write to present a settlement demand on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], arising from the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Your insured's vehicle crossed into the opposing lane and struck our client's vehicle head-on. Although the impact occurred at a low rate of speed, the force transferred enough to cause our client immediate and ongoing harm.

Following the collision, our client was evaluated and diagnosed with cervical and lumbar strain. Symptoms include persistent neck stiffness, restricted range of motion, lower back pain, and headaches. Our client has attended a course of physical therapy and has been advised to limit lifting and prolonged driving while recovery continues. Treatment records and billing statements are enclosed for your review.

Liability in this matter is clear. The police report documents your insured's failure to maintain control of the vehicle, and no evidence suggests our client contributed to the collision in any way.

Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all bodily injury claims against your insured. This demand will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice to your office.

We look forward to your prompt reply.
